title: SEAdLINNNG Let's Get d!!!
overview: Let's Get d!!! was a professional wrestling event promoted by SEAdLINNNG, held on March 7, 2016 at Korakuen Hall in Tokyo, Japan. It was the promotion's fourth overall show, and notably featured the return of Yoshiko to professional wrestling following her legitimate mid-match attack on Act Yasukawa and subsequent retirement announcement in 2015 - acts that led directly to SEAdLINNNG's creation by her opponent, Nanae Takahashi.
